meta.topic: Interrogation regarding the theft of the 'Star of Midnight' diamond.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: Julian Vance, I've reviewed your alibi for the time of the theft, and I'd like to clarify a few discrepancies. You claimed to be at a dinner party at the Langham Hotel from 20:00 to 22:00, but one of your acquaintances told me you left around 21:30 to make a phone call. Can you explain why your phone records show no activity during that time?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: I must have misremembered the timing of my departure. I did indeed leave the dinner party to make a phone call, but I must have forgotten to update my records. The call was a personal matter, and I didn't think it was relevant to the evening's events.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: I see. So, you're saying the call was a personal matter, but you didn't think it was relevant to the theft. That's interesting, because one of the dinner party guests reported seeing you lingering around the Langham Hotel's lobby around 21:45, just before the theft was reported. Can you account for your presence there?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: I was simply waiting for a colleague to finish a meeting, and I must have walked into the lobby to wait for them. I didn't see or hear anything unusual, and I was definitely not in the vicinity of the display case.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: I've spoken to the colleague you mentioned, and they claim you were actually waiting for them in the hotel's bar, not the lobby. Furthermore, they said you were on your phone, chatting with someone, and seemed quite agitated. Can you explain why your phone records show a call to an unknown number at 21:42, just 3 minutes before the theft was reported?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: I... uh... I think I must have misremembered the conversation I was having. It was probably just a routine call to a business associate, and I must have gotten the timing wrong. I'm sure it had nothing to do with the theft.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: I've obtained the phone records for the unknown number, and it appears to be a number registered to a shell company with ties to the diamond trade. The conversation was brief, but it seems to have been a discussion about the Star of Midnight diamond. Care to explain why you would be in contact with someone who might be interested in the very same diamond that was just stolen?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: (pausing, choosing words carefully) I... uh... I think I may have been in contact with a... a collector, yes, that's it. A collector who was interested in purchasing the Star of Midnight. I was simply providing him with some information about the diamond's provenance. (pausing again) I assure you, our conversation was purely innocent and had nothing to do with the theft.
